name: LifeMint 1.4.8
body:
• Apple Watch redesign: a glanceable home, quick start, a dedicated Today's 3 page, a full-screen timer, and new complications.
• Paycheck reconciliation: pick the actual arrival date freely — no pay schedule needed.
• iPhone Duo support: two panes when open or half-folded, and your running timer and unsaved entries survive every fold.
• Larger text: titles, buttons and lists no longer break mid-word or cut off.
• Faster and more stable.

name: LifeMint 1.4.7
body:
A clearer view of your time and earnings.

• Monthly Review reminders help you look back before the month ends.
• Records now show activity mode colours and a daily rhythm chart, with a clearer yearly heatmap summary.
• Compare earnings across periods in a new animated receipt view. Weekly earnings now include paycheque tips.
• Choose work dates and the actual paycheque arrival date directly on the calendar, without a preset pay schedule or a 14-day limit. Already reconciled work dates stay grey and locked.
• Pay schedule settings, forecast cards and predicted-payday reminders have been removed.
• Receive a Pomodoro completion notification when the timer finishes in the background.
• Improved decimal entry in amount fields, including comma keyboards.

name: LifeMint 1.4.6
body:
• LifeMint is now available in Spanish.
• The comma key now types a decimal point in every amount field, for phones whose region uses a comma.
• Japanese and Korean: the Pro screen and date headers are fully translated.
• Clearer amounts when you track more than one currency.
• Smaller fixes and polish.

name: LifeMint 1.4.5
body:
• Biweekly paydays now follow a fixed anchor date, so your payday countdown stays on a steady 14-day rhythm.
• Apple Watch: see your next payday and this month's workout check-ins at a glance.
• CSV export and import now cover expenses, fixed bills, budgets, and workouts.
• Payday countdown and monthly check-ins now refresh more reliably.

name: LifeMint 1.4.4
body:
LifeMint 1.4.4 strengthens bills, widgets, and the four module home pages.

• Monthly expenses return with a unified header across Study, Work, Expense, and Gym
• Bill reminders up to a year ahead
• Per-profile payday widget and Watch payday / monthly workout check-ins
• CSV export and import for expenses, fixed bills, budgets, and workouts
• Biweekly paydays follow a fixed anchor-date cadence

name: LifeMint 1.4.3
body:
LifeMint 1.4.3 refines Home, shifts, and Pro presentation.

• Home and Profile redesign with clearer Life Ring hero tiles
• Overnight shifts with safer editing after midnight
• Native holographic Pro membership card with verified purchase reference
• Spend purple styling across expense screens
• Goals with activity shortcuts and clearer editor contrast

name: LifeMint 1.4.2
body:
LifeMint 1.4.2 deepens paycheck tools and earnings detail.

• One-page Add Paycheque flow with job picker and calendar range
• Paycheck reconciliation scoped to work profiles
• Paycheque tips and paycheck history navigation fixes
• Smarter paycheck forecast and payday resolution

name: LifeMint 1.4.1

name: LifeMint 1.4.0
body:
LifeMint 1.4.0 makes it easier to begin, stay focused, and keep your week in view.

• A new modular Start page on Apple Watch for Study, Work, Expense, and Gym
• Start Study and Work from synced iPhone quick starts
• Clearer iPhone handoff for Expense and Gym
• Refined Watch navigation with Now first and Start one swipe away
• More reliable Apple Health connection and workout syncing
• Smoother onboarding, accessibility, and general performance improvements

name: LifeMint 1.3.6
body:
Apple Health is now a clearly integrated part of LifeMint Fitness.

• Imported workouts power fitness history, weekly goals, charts, activity insights, and Weekly Review
• Improved Connect Apple Health reliability with a timeout and visible error state
• Added a clear explanation when Apple Health is unavailable on a device
• Clarified read-only workout access and privacy messaging
• Improved Fitness dashboard placement so Apple Health is easy to find

body:
What's New in This Version

Custom Modes: Personalize your focus sessions with Custom Emoji icons! 
Watch Sync: Your custom modes now sync automatically and permanently to your Apple Watch.
Send Feedback: Reach out to us directly via the new Feedback section in your Profile. 
UI Refinement: Enhanced Dark Mode support and optimized layouts for a smoother experience.
Bug Fixes: Squashed various UI bugs across both iPhone and Watch apps.
Language: Added French supportz!
